title: Acceptance-evaluation policy form: a normal Save that keeps the operator's edits on a conflict and warns only on an actual reduction
outcome: Carries the TermAl part of Engram w-e57091faa4e5 ("Make ordinary policy settings a normal Save operation"), at Engram::Fable's request (mailbox ebe242f7 #351, 2026-09-30), triaged read-only against TermAl d2cb603 by Engram::Opus. Engram's part is delivered (Engram w-a562563fed5c): the policy setters need only --authorized-by, an idempotency key and an optional expected policy hash, with no reason, and the receipt returns the previous and the new policy. What remains is TermAl's. Today a first-attempt 409 closes the editor and reloads from the store, losing the operator's edits (ui/src/AcceptanceEvaluationSettings.tsx about lines 105–110, and a test enforces the reload). A generic warning is always shown (about line 159). Scope: the acceptance-evaluation policy form only. The turn-gated toggle and its Verify step belong with w-5b6ef1e321ae and Engram w-67775bc92f06. An unchanged submission may succeed as an idempotent no-op. Bookkeeping in scope: w-e4a5b3186aa0 (tm-4ilz) and w-1887d5476ed7 (tm-uyx2) are still ready with no criteria although their code landed in 513018d; close them against this item or their own evidence.
acceptance: A concurrency refusal (409) on Save does not lose the operator's edits: the form keeps them, shows the store's current values beside them, and lets the operator re-apply or discard; a test covers a first-attempt 409 and replaces the test that enforces the reload.
The form uses plain wording with Save and Cancel; a test covers Cancel discarding the edits without a request.
The full five-stage gate passes on the exact reviewed tree, its run directory and fingerprint cited in a note.

The reduction warning appears only for an actual reduction computed from the receipt's previous and new policy (fewer modes, a looser basis or freshness), never as an always-shown line; tests cover a reduction and a non-reduction.
w-e4a5b3186aa0 and w-1887d5476ed7 are closed against this item or their own evidence, with the closing reason recorded on each.
